covers.title: Interaction Closure: What Business Voice AI Needs
covers.subject: Flexible conversational paths remain governed by a complete business interaction space, including correction. One large OPEN blue geometric enclosure with a thin but substantial structural rim and TRANSPARENT INTERIOR supports three distinct connected business-state forms: a cream circle, a teal inset square and a blue diamond, each with one simple internal mark. Three different flowing ribbon paths enter the governed state space from different directions. One clean return loop shows correction and continued conversation. Frame and paths must be visually balanced, with a much lighter frame than the reference, no filled backplate. It must not look like a funnel, finish line, locked gate or a conversation-ending door. Wide enclosure silhouette.

covers.title: Table reservation CUI design
covers.subject: Conversation gathers and revises the details needed for a valid table reservation. Distinct top-down CIRCULAR silhouette: one large blue round restaurant table with two simple teal chair forms at opposite sides, two small cream place-setting circles. A single cream reservation strip overlaps one edge with three large clean information marks: a pair of guest dots, a simple divided time slot, and a solid confirmation lozenge, no readable text or numbers. One expressive teal conversation ribbon reaches the strip and makes a small return loop to the time-slot mark, suggesting a correction. A warm but precise geometric editorial scene; no perspective restaurant furniture, cutlery, vases or floating chat bubbles. Main forms must be unmistakable at small size. Open transparent background and no enclosure or backplate.

covers.title: You don't need an omnipotent AI agent
covers.subject: A coordinated team of specialists keeps separate operational responsibilities and limited permissions. Three upright clearly bounded geometric WORKSTATIONS, each a distinct separate vertical structure, joined only by one common lower blue rail. First compartment contains a simple cream time-slot structure with one teal movable bar; second contains two contrasting folded blue and cream response strips; third contains a simple teal shaped tool fitting precisely into its cream matching socket. Large clear shapes, not miniature pictograms. All three bounded structures should have equal weight and transparent space between them. A strong segmented THREE-COLUMN silhouette, not a giant common rectangle or dashboard. Communicate distinct tools and isolated authority coordinated at their bases. No robots, people, gears, monitors, realistic desks or tiny calendar grids.

covers.title: Prompt Engineering will never be fully deterministic
covers.subject: One flexible natural-language input can produce varied interpretations; an explicitly defined interface constrains behavior. A deliberate asymmetric SIDE-BY-SIDE comparison. On one side, a single cream loose input strip carrying two expressive wavy BLUE ink marks leads into three distinct blue and teal flowing paths that end in three visibly DIFFERENT large geometric forms: circle, diamond and short bar. Beside that, a narrow precise blue guide with teal parallel rails holds three IDENTICAL cream square tokens aligned in a single straight orderly track. Both sides are equally intentional, neither portrayed as broken. Distinct loose branching versus constrained repeatability. Large legible relationships, no written prompts, no schematic labels, no tiny diagrams, no background enclosure, no UI windows. The split composition is the cover silhouette.

covers.title: Reuse reservation module to build chatbot
covers.subject: Reuse an already-complete reservation module by connecting it to a conversational application and a calendar provider. Distinct LATERAL INSERTION composition: a large open blue application frame has an empty socket on one side; one INTACT teal rectangular module with a simple large cream reservation mark aligns with and is partly inserted into that matching socket. The module must clearly be one finished self-contained piece, not multiple loose parts. A single short blue connector reaches a small separate cream ledger at the other side, with only three large teal time-slot bars. One simple folded response strip lives inside the application frame to suggest its conversational role, not a screen UI. Shape fit and one clean connection tell the story. Transparent interior and gaps, no common background backplate, no tools, servers, calendar pictogram, tiny wiring or text.

covers.title: Build a reservation module
covers.subject: Construct a reusable reservation capability from explicit fields, types and rules. Distinct compact ASSEMBLY composition: one broad open blue frame has three visibly different empty matching slots. Above it, three large separate purposeful components align with their individual slots: a cream divided time-slot bar, a teal circle containing two cream guest dots, and a blue confirmation diamond with one cream inset. Use short deliberate alignment marks, no tangled arrows. Make the relationship between each unique component and its matching cavity exceptionally clear. Their bases are near the frame but not yet installed, conveying construction rather than finished capability reuse. Transparent gaps and open interior. No toolbox, wrench, gears, literal jigsaw edges, app window, monitor or large filled background plate.

covers.title: From schema to snippets: a blueprint for chatbot
covers.subject: A single explicit structured service schema supports several contextual conversational examples. Distinct DIAGONAL FAN composition: a crisp blue schema plane with three large cream inset field marks forms the structural anchor, with a sparse teal branching spine connecting the fields. From two of those fields, clean short connectors lead to two contrasting folded conversational strips fanning out diagonally. One strip has a pair of blue and cream speech-like shapes with expressive wavy marks; the other has an alternate rhythm of teal response shapes, making different conversational contexts visible while their shared source remains clear. Folded strips, not screens or rectangular app tiles. Structure becomes varied expression. No words, text, code, numbers, tiny connector nodes, pencil or desk props. No large common backplate.

covers.title: Chatbot development with OpenCUI
covers.subject: A conversational application combines language understanding, reusable interaction components and backend services. Distinct STEPPED ARCHITECTURAL silhouette: three flat offset blue/teal layers in a restrained exploded view, separated by transparent gaps and a few short precise connections. Top language layer carries two expressive cream/teal flowing marks. Middle interaction layer has two large different geometric pieces fitted into corresponding constraints. Bottom service foundation has three clean cream sockets connected by one solid teal bus. Arrange the layers as staggered purposeful graphic planes, not thick 3D trays; very small consistent offset shadows only. Visually connect all three layers to convey composition, not a pile of disconnected slabs. No monitor, server rack, brain, gear, robot, dense wiring, UI or text.
